objective: Data and presentation pieces for Typeless's 洞察 dashboard, history retention and appearance, without touching desktop.py. (1) voice2txt/core.py: MODES gains 'ask': '隨便問'; Store gets `prune(days)` (delete rows older than N days, returns count; days None = keep all), `rows_for_stats()` returning (created ISO string, mode, seconds, text) for all rows, and `update_text(row_id, text)`.
